xpath.div:
What is an Operation? An Operation is a single production step — for example Cutting, Stitching, or Printing. Each operation is linked to one Hall (Work Center) and is added to a Bill of Materials so that when a Manufacturing Order is confirmed, the system automatically creates a Work Order for that hall.
The Piece Rate and Pay Basis fields here control how contractors in that hall get paid: the rate comes from the Piece Rates list and the pay basis decides whether payment is calculated per ball or per hall unit logged. The Balls per Unit factor converts logged hall units into balls for reporting.

field.name: expense_account_id
field.invisible: workforce_type == 'employee' and not is_initial_qc and not is_final_qc

field.name: is_initial_qc
field.help: Enable for the ILO Initial QC hall — logging a batch here opens the Pass/Fail-to-repair/Scrap modal instead of the normal one.

field.name: is_final_qc
field.help: Enable for the ILO Final QC hall — logging a batch here (HS construction only) opens its own Pass/Fail-to-repair/Scrap modal with a self-contained repair loop, separate from Initial QC.

field.name: is_packing
field.help: Enable if this work center is the packing stage. The MO's quantity-producing counter will be driven by batch entries logged here.

field.name: is_ilo
field.help: Enable if this work center represents the ILO (hand stitching) external step. Completion will be gated on ILO receipt confirmation.

field.name: is_ball_receive_point
field.help: Enable for the dedicated hall where balls dispatched to an ILO contractor are logged back in — works for any construction type (HS, HYB, THB, etc). Must be its own work center, not shared with another step.

xpath.div: To add SFG products: go to Manufacturing → Products → New, set Product Group = Semi-Finished Good and Type = Storable.
To add hall locations: go to Inventory → Configuration → Locations and create Internal type locations under a Production Halls parent (Type: View).

tr.td: MO has been created but not yet confirmed. Fields are still editable. Work orders are not active yet.
MO is confirmed. Work orders are now active. The Store Keeper can now issue raw materials via Material Issuance. Hall supervisors can begin logging batch progress once materials are issued.
Production is underway. At least one work order has been started. Batch logs are being recorded across halls.
All work orders are completed. MO is closed. Final status. No further changes allowed.
MO was cancelled. All work orders are also cancelled. No production was recorded under this MO.
